messages:
marta: quick sync — i opened a docs PR to clarify audit-log archival exceptions and legal-hold behavior for SOC2 language. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/324. can @legal and @kevin glance? wondering about exact phrasing for 'temporary hold' vs 'suspend deletion' and an example sdk snippet for exporting redacted audit logs.

kevin: looking now. one quick thing — for deleted tenants we say 'data is removed from active storage and queued for permanent purge at TTL expiry'. do we want to explicitly call out legal holds as an override?

anna: +1 to calling it out. suggested wording: "When a legal hold is applied, retention timers are suspended for the affected records until the hold is lifted. Otherwise, records are subject to configured TTLs and automated redaction workflows." short and SOC2-friendly.

legal: thanks anna. prefer 'suspend retention' instead of 'suspend deletion' (less alarming). also add a line: "We retain audit events beyond the configured TTL only when required by court order, subpoena, or similar legal process." that helps auditors.

marta: perfect. i'll swap wording. also adding an example curl + py snippet for docs consumers who need exported redacted logs. posting draft snippet — feedback welcome:

```bash
# request an export; redaction=summary removes PII fields
curl -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"start_time":"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2025-02-01T00:00:00Z","redaction":"summary","include_system_events":false}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports
```

```python
# python example using our client
from redwood import AuditExportClient
client = AuditExportClient(api_key=os.getenv('API_KEY'))
job = client.create_export(start="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", end="2025-02-01T00:00:00Z", redaction_mode='summary')
print(job['id'])
```

kevin: snippet looks good. couple small asks: 1) show expected response shape (id, status, download_url when ready), 2) note that exports are async and may be delayed under heavy load; include TTL for how long the export artifact is available.

marta: added expected response example and a note that export artifacts are available for 7 days by default. also added a short table in the docs: 'when retention is suspended' rows: legal hold, active investigation, regulatory request.

docs-bot: FYI — i updated the PR description with the legal team's suggested lines and the export snippet under 'Audit Export examples'.

kevin: final nit — replace 'permanent purge' with 'irreversible deletion' in one spot to avoid 'permanent' phrasing. other than that, LGTM from security side.

marta: done. merging after CI passes. thanks all :thumbsup: 

anna: can someone add a cross-link to the compliance playbook page for 'legal hold request process'? will help support and customers.

marta: good call. filing a follow-up doc issue and linking it in the PR.

legal: approving language for SOC2 doc excerpt. please keep the exact sentence we agreed in audit checklist (we'll reference it in evidence pack).

marta: saved the agreed sentence in the evidence pack note. closing thread.
